mentions.description: A personal website (dvsj.in) that the author is redesigning to be weirder. The headline idea is an 'ask your LLM' feature on the email submission form: buttons that open ChatGPT, Perplexity, or Claude with a pre-filled query asking the LLM why the visitor should be friends with the author.
mentions.source_excerpt:
Not as impressive, but - making my website weirder. Not a frontend dev at work.

Top of my ideas now: add "ask your LLM" buttons to my email submission form that opens ChatGPT/Perp/Claude and auto-fills a query asking it why you should be friends with me.
